actions.label: Give a gift
actions.you: On your word, {A} looks after {T} today.
actions.owner: {A} looks after {T}, on a word from home.

actions.label: Give advice
actions.you: {A} takes your advice to heart and tries to be {axis}.
actions.owner: {A} takes some advice from home and tries to be {axis}.

actions.label: Set a task
actions.you: {A} spends the shift on {res}, as you asked.
actions.owner: {A} spends the shift on {res}, on a word from home.

actions.label: Tell them to rest
actions.you: {A} takes the day off, on your orders.
actions.owner: {A} takes the day off, on a word from home.

notes: You still owe me a coffee.
Don't do anything brave without me.

sys.move: {A} rides the transfer line across to {S} for a few days, and leaves the home ship flying itself, as it was built to.
sys.home: {A} rides the transfer line back home to {S}.
sys.dec_close: With the ballots in, the fleet's advice: {opt}.
sys.dec_lean: No votes came in, so the flight director went with the crew's lean: {opt}.
sys.dec_tie: Split down the middle, {n} votes. The flight director takes the crew's lean: {opt}.
sys.dil_self: No word from home in time, so {A} chose: {opt}.
sys.res_open: Anyone can answer; one tap is enough.
sys.res_default: No answer in time, so it fell to the crew: {opt}.
sys.fold: On the other ships, {who} ran the water rounds and checked the recovery rate.
fold_pool: On the other ships, {who} ran the water rounds and checked the recovery rate.
{who} chased rattles behind panels and found pens.
{who} swapped scrubber cartridges two days early, because the trend lines said so.
{who} answered mail from home: weather, a dog, a fence that needs mending.
{who} reran pump checks that came back two tenths off, then on.
{who} cleaned galley filters and found a missing spoon.
{who} counted spare fuses twice and got the same numbers both times.
{who} recalibrated cabin sensors reading half a degree warm.
{who} swept cabins with leak detectors and found nothing, which is the point.
{who} re-torqued hatch hinges to spec and wrote down the numbers.
{who} logged cabin air and found it dull, which is good.
{who} wiped down windows and watched Mars not move.
{who} ran comms self-tests and filed clean sheets.
{who} slept nine hours on the flight surgeon's orders.
{who} walked hulls with the camera and found them whole.
{who} stripped and re-taped frayed cable runs.

axis: Checked every seal twice, and was thanked for it.
Has a notebook full of things worth a second look.
Kept a seat free at every long table.
Said the true thing when it needed saying.
epi.plain: Kept the ship running, quietly and well. The checklists say so, in small handwriting.
head: Seven ships, seven crews, every one accounted for.
Seven ships, one planet, and every seal held.
story: e_entry_hold_q
Took the landing back from a gust on a slope, and kept the ship upright on a folded strut.
e_entry_hold
Called the manual takeover at three hundred metres in the brown, and put the ship down on the flat.
e_entry_wait
Came out of the blackout nine seconds late, reading the orbit numbers aloud.
a_window_hail
Set an answer running weeks early. The printout of the first OK is over the habitat bunk.
a_window_quiet
Wanted to answer weeks early, then carried the answer the last stretch in person.
e_entry_clear
Heard an engine light late at the landing burn, and kept the engine-out call behind their teeth.
m_carrier
Still scans the old channel every night, out of habit.
m_reveal
Got the lighthouse wrong and the keeper right. The drawing hangs by the airlock.
m_theory
Ran out of blue marker in the first month on Mars.
a_list
Got an answer from every name on the list, one postmarked from the sea, and read each aloud, pauses included.
g_news
Has a folding chair saved by the sea, for later.
p_live_call
Kept a list of who was at the table.
a_song
Taught the fifth bar to six people who had guessed it wrong.
p_music
Never told anyone the song's name.
p_garden_sprout
Strapped the seedling beside the seat, and planted it in the lee of the ship.
p_garden_none
Carried a seed that never came up all the way to Mars, to plant it properly.
p_garden_plant
Still says good night to the plants, out loud, on Mars.
letter_open
Saved a letter for the hard day, and knows its last line by heart.
letter_worn
Wore a letter thin at the fold, and read its last line aloud at Mars.
a_letter
Read the last line of a letter aloud, at Mars.
dose_swap
Moved the bunk to the water wall on a crewmate's newer calibration, and slept.
dose_ok
Thanked the ground for checking, and slept beside the water wall until entry pumped it down.
a_last_night
Sleeps by water, still, and sleeps well.
l_dose
Topped the fleet's dose chart, and flew on.
m_flash1
Kept both timestamps. Still has them.
m_overlay
Put two traces side by side. Didn't look away.
sharpie2
Knows a handwriting from Starbase on sight.
l_stash
Found the first of the notes.
m_ripple
Heard the knock first, in the noise floor, and blamed a pump.
crisis_eva
Landed with a wrist that bends again.

coda.name: Cargo 2
lines: Wrote when it landed. Kept writing. Spent its lights bringing seven down.
Kept the beat for seven blind pilots, and was answered on the rim.
Kept a lamp lit for three weeks of passes.
Kept knocking through the cold, and was answered by hand.
Gave a truck the charge it kept for the cold.
Heard back once, and it was enough.
Wrote when it landed. Kept writing. Was answered in time.
